Computer Programming 2
BSIT
This course introduces object-oriented programming concepts and develops practical skills through Java. Students explain classes and methods, implement reusable components, test program behavior and develop applications. They analyze requirements and evaluate solutions through guided practice, collaborative programming and individual projects. Ethical teamwork, attribution and responsible use of computing resources support the technical objectives of the course through varied learning and assessment activities.
